Method of Attack: Information-stealing malware targeting web browsers and cryptocurrency wallet apps
Steals data from victim's web browsers and cryptocurrency wallet apps
Uses fake blockchain games as delivery mechanism
Password stealing via AppleScript and osascript spoofing
Extracts data from macOS keychain database
Uses Terminal window to prompt for password to dump Keychain credentials
Installs Python cryptography library to dump credentials from Keychain
Attack Vector: Fake blockchain games distributed via social media and Discord channels
Direct messages with access codes to download fake game clients
PKG installers or DMG disk files containing malicious Mach-O files for macOS
Windows malware delivered as fake game installers
Indicators of Compromise: Fake game names: Brawl Earth, WildWorld, Dawnland, Destruction, Evolion, Pearl, Olymp of Reptiles, SaintLegend
Use of revoked Apple Developer IDs or ad-hoc code signatures
Folders named 'data' in user home, working directory, or parent game folder
Strings targeting macOS 14 Sonoma in about 30% of samples
